purpose: Allow Venue Chat to freeze and hand off pre-race supplemental factual sources when official JRA source-only coverage is insufficient, while preserving the existing Production Evidence Rule Registry and Production Evidence-to-Base Mapping.
rules: Supplemental sources must be captured before prediction_cutoff.
Each source must carry source_id, source_class, authority, origin, available_at, ingested_at and SHA256.
Only rule_id values already registered in JRA-EVIDENCE-FEATURE-RULE-REGISTRY-v1.1-20260922 are accepted.
Only categories already defined by JRA-EVIDENCE-TO-BASE-MAPPING-v1.0-PRODUCTION-20260921 are accepted.
The pack cannot create new numerical weights, mapping rules, KRS authority, MEC rules or Capital policy.
Official Signed SOURCE remains mandatory when required; supplemental evidence augments but never replaces it.
Full Numerical is claimed only after existing Production materializer closes FULL_REQUIRED.
failure_policy: FAIL-CLOSED / NO SILENT NEUTRAL / NO UNKNOWN->WEAK / NO SHADOW AUTO-PROMOTION
oos_requirement: NO NEW PREDICTIVE POLICY; OOS measurement continues on resulting frozen Production decisions.
